description: Pinned nickname PR214 only; install separately; default read-only check; no bootstrap or explicit rollback

runCommand:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
wrapper=/usr/local/sbin/xamuko-nickname214-deploy
[[ $(stat -c '%u:%a' "$wrapper") == 0:755 && ! -L "$wrapper" ]]
printf '%s  %s\n' '0e5948388f237c37de9d8ec67f134a2c00a72c4c71d868155e8d4df59b2ba704' "$wrapper" | sha256sum -c -
if [[ "{{ Action }}" == check ]]; then
  exec /usr/bin/python3 "$wrapper" check
fi
exec /usr/bin/python3 "$wrapper" deploy "{{ ArtifactBucket }}" "{{ ArtifactVersionId }}"
